name: vibehub-plugin
description: Plugin-first local context runtime for Claude Code and Codex.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @vw-ai/vibehub-core build && pnpm --filter @vw-ai/vibehub-cli build && pnpm --filter @vw-ai/vibehub-workbench-mcp build
scripts.pack:npm: pnpm build && pnpm verify:npm-packages && node scripts/pack-npm-packages.mjs
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @vw-ai/vibehub-core typecheck && pnpm --filter @vw-ai/vibehub-cli typecheck && pnpm --filter @vw-ai/vibehub-workbench-mcp typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @vw-ai/vibehub-core test && pnpm --filter @vw-ai/vibehub-cli test && pnpm --filter @vw-ai/vibehub-workbench-mcp test
scripts.verify:npm-release: pnpm build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm verify:npm-packages && node scripts/pack-npm-packages.mjs && pnpm verify:npm-install
scripts.verify: pnpm build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm verify:npm-packages && node scripts/pack-npm-packages.mjs && pnpm verify:npm-install && pnpm verify:artifact && pnpm verify:codex-plugin && pnpm verify:host-installer && pnpm verify:runtime-concurrency && pnpm dogfood
